Aster DM Quality Care Limited has released the transcript of its Q1 FY27 earnings conference call held on August 5, 2026. The company reported a **20% year-on-year increase in revenue** to INR 2,597 crore, with EBITDA growing **30%** to INR 576 crore.

## Drivers of Growth
The company treated over **2 million patients** in Q1, a **13% year-on-year increase**.

## Clinical Excellence and Expansion
Aster DM Quality Care emphasized its commitment to clinical excellence and expanding geographic access. The company is focusing on scaling super-specialty care, medical expansion into Tier 2 and Tier 3 markets, and driving patient-centric innovation through digital platforms. Plans are in place to add over **4,170 beds** in the next three to four years, taking the total capacity to over **15,000 beds**.
